title: Group Preference Collapse in Personalized Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.22603v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Personalized multimodal large language models (MLLMs) aim to generate user-specific responses, but existing methods mainly rely on profile-level information and overlook diverse user preferences. We identify group preference collapse, where multi-user personalized MLLMs become insensitive to individual preferences and drift toward dominant population-level choices due to suppressed preference signals and unreliable preference use during generation. We propose PrefMoE, a preference-centric framework that separates stable profile information from preference-related representations. PrefMoE decomposes preferences into shared prototypes and personalized residuals, preserves individualized residuals with imbalance-aware learning, counterfactual pseudo-user augmentation, and residual decorrelation, and routes profile and preference factors through separate LoRA adaptation paths. translated_title: 个性化多模态大语言模型中的群体偏好坍缩
translated_abstract: 个性化多模态大语言模型（MLLM）旨在生成针对特定用户的响应，但现有方法主要依赖用户画像层面的信息，忽视了多样化的用户偏好。我们识别出一种“群体偏好坍缩”现象：多用户个性化MLLM对个体偏好变得不敏感，由于偏好信号被抑制以及生成过程中偏好使用不可靠，而向占主导地位的群体层面选择漂移。我们提出PrefMoE，这是一个以偏好为中心的框架，将稳定的用户画像信息与偏好相关的表征分离开来。PrefMoE将偏好分解为共享原型和个性化残差，通过不平衡感知学习、反事实伪用户增强和残差去相关来保留个性化残差，并通过独立的LoRA适配路径分别处理用户画像因素和偏好因素。在多个MLLM骨干模型上的实验表明，PrefMoE……
tldr: 提出PrefMoE框架，通过将偏好分解为共享原型与个性化残差、采用不平衡感知学习等策略保护个体偏好，并利用分离的LoRA适配路径处理画像与偏好信息，从而解决多用户个性化多模态大语言模型中的群体偏好坍缩问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes PrefMoE, a preference-centric framework that decomposes preferences into shared prototypes and personalized residuals—preserved via imbalance-aware learning, counterfactual pseudo-user augmentation, and residual decorrelation—with separate LoRA paths for profile and preference factors, to address group preference collapse in multi-user personalized multimodal LLMs.
